propositions: The GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext via query string (?token=) in uvicorn access logs before fix 66af was deployed

Fix 66af (Gerrit 1384) moves token sourcing from URL query parameter to X-Rebar-Token header and installs TokenRedactingFilter to redact logs, but was not deployed to production before rotation attempt

GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN serves three purposes simultaneously: Gerrit HTTP basic-auth password (outbound), inbound webhook secret, and container environment variable, requiring atomic rotation via service-user.sh
Rotating the compromised token before deploying 66af code would re-expose the new token immediately on next webhook call

Correct sequence requires: deploy 66af to prod, rotate token via service-user.sh (Gerrit password + SSM + webhooks.config), restart container, verify inbound webhook and outbound LLM-Review vote both work
